app.name: SuperTrello
button.toolbar.name: SuperTrello
connect.title: Connect your Trello account
connect.intro: SuperTrello needs access to your Trello account to show your boards.
connect.step1: 1. Open this address in a web browser (on this tablet or on another device), sign in to Trello and press Allow:
connect.step2: 2. Trello then displays a token. Type it below:
connect.storageWarning: This tablet offers no persistent storage to plugins: you will need to connect again after a restart.
boards.title: Your boards
boards.loadFailed: Your boards could not be loaded.
error.missingApiKey: No Trello API key is configured in this build. See the README.
error.permissionDenied: Internet access was denied. Allow it so SuperTrello can reach Trello.
error.malformedToken: This does not look like a Trello token. Check what you typed.
error.invalidToken: Trello rejected the token. Generate a new one and try again.
error.network: Trello could not be reached. Check the Wi-Fi connection.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests to Trello. Wait a moment and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.browserUnavailable: No browser could be opened. Type the address on another device.
